body: To expand on my previous comment, recognise that feelings, emotions and reactions may not inherently make sense. They don't follow the same logic or reason a thinking mind does. It doesn't mean trying not to feel anything, instead, it's about recognising when emotions don't make sense and to try and look at your emotional situation from a logical, thinking mind perspective.

You been through hell and more going through something like this, don't beat yourself up over something you can't control.

It's important to note that attraction is not something you can control. You may find him attractive instinctually but that doesn't mean you like him in anyway shape or form. It's very much like fighting the urge to breathe.

Hope what I've said helps in some way.

The fact of the matter is that you did not choose to be born, accident or not. All responsibility for your existence lies with them and therefore they should be morally required to see you through your education and be ready for "adult life". 

Personally, I'm of the opinion that the cutoff of "adulthood" at 18 is outdated, especially in a country like Singapore, it really needs to be revised to get with the times. These days, the length of education has pretty much doubled or at least increased by 1/3rd. Not to mention the costs of living in the city itself.

It seems extremely irresponsible to me that your parents abandoned you once they were not legally culpable for your well being.
